_comment: This is the main biome of the Astra dimension (it is used in data/per_aspera_ad_astra/dimension/astra_dim.json).
Copy this file with a new name (e.g. ice_wastes.json) to make another biome, then add it to astra_dim.json.
Colors are decimal numbers. Convert hex to decimal, e.g. #7A3CFF = 8010751.
>>> WHERE TO ADD OUR MOD BLOCKS <<<
Blocks are NOT listed in the biome directly. You add them through 'features':
1. Make a configured_feature (WHAT block + HOW it is shaped)   -> worldgen/configured_feature/
2. Make a placed_feature (HOW OFTEN + WHERE / at which height) -> worldgen/placed_feature/
3. Add the placed_feature's id to the right list in 'features' below.
Examples already done: erz_ore (Erz Block underground) and eis_patch (Eisblock on the surface).
_features_help: The 'features' list above MUST have exactly 11 inner lists, in this order:
6 strongholds | 7 underground_ores  <-- ADD MOD ORES HERE (like erz_ore)
10 vegetal_decoration  <-- ADD SURFACE BLOCKS / PATCHES / PLANTS HERE (like eis_patch)
If you add vanilla features (minecraft:...), keep them in the same order vanilla uses,
otherwise the game crashes with 'Feature order cycle found'.
